# Set Up

Load packages:

```{r message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(wesanderson)
```

Specify file path: 

```{r}
fp = "../results/"
#fp = "~/../../Volumes/subseasonal_extreme/"
```

# Data Steps

Load and clean RMSEs:

```{r}
cv_rmses <-
  readr::read_csv(
    file = paste0(fp, "cv-rmses.csv"), 
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(file = str_remove(file, ".csv")) |>
  separate(
    file,
    c(
      "target_region",
      "tau",
      "m",
      "nlayers",
      "nh",
      "nu",
      "nens"
    ),
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    target_region = str_remove(target_region, "targetregion"),
    tau = as.numeric(str_remove(tau, "tau")),
    m = as.numeric(str_remove(m, "m")),
    nlayers = as.numeric(str_remove(nlayers, "nlayers")),
    nh = as.numeric(str_remove(nh, "nh")),
    nu = as.numeric(str_remove(nu, "nu")) / 100,
    nens = as.numeric(str_remove(nens, "nens")),
  )
```

# Best RMSEs

Determine which parameters resulted in the lowest RMSEs, extreme RMSEs, and weighted RMSEs (for both cases with all 5 folds or only 4th and 5th folds):

```{r}
best_rmses <-
  cv_rmses |>
  select(-file) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rmse, rmse_extreme, rmse_weighted), 
    names_to = "rmse_type", 
    values_to = "rmse"
  ) |>
  filter(
    rmse == min(rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .by = c(target_region, tau, rmse_type, folds)
  )
```

Print the best RMSEs:

```{r}
best_rmses |>
  filter(rmse_type == "rmse") |>
  mutate(
    rmse = round(rmse, 2)
  ) |>
  arrange(target_region, tau) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

Print the best extreme RMSEs:

```{r}
best_rmses |>
  filter(rmse_type == "rmse_extreme") |>
  mutate(
    rmse = round(rmse, 2)
  ) |>
  arrange(target_region, tau) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

Print the best weighted RMSEs:

```{r}
best_rmses |>
  filter(rmse_type == "rmse_weighted") |>
  mutate(
    rmse = round(rmse, 2)
  ) |>
  arrange(target_region, tau) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

Plot the best RMSEs:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 8
#| echo: false
best_rmses |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tau, y = rmse, group = target_region, color = target_region)) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(folds ~ rmse_type) +
  theme_light() + 
  labs(
    x = "Weeks Forecasted",
    y = "RMSE",
    title = "RMSEs by region (averaged over all test data)",
    color = "Region"
  ) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = wes_palette(name = "Zissou1", n = 5, type = "continuous")
  )
```

Plot the comparison of RMSEs between the best tuning parameters determine based on all folds or only folds 4 and 5.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
#| echo: false
best_rmses |>
  mutate(
    rmse = round(rmse, 2)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tau, y = rmse, color = folds)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(rmse_type ~ target_region) + #, scales = "free_y") + 
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    x = "Forecast Horizon (weeks)",
    y = "RMSE",
    color = "Folds"
  )
```

Save best RMSEs (only from folds 4 and 5):

```{r}
best_rmses |> 
  filter(folds == "4_and_5", rmse_type == "rmse") |> 
  select(-rmse_type) |>
  write.csv(
    paste0(fp, "cv-rmses-best.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
```

# Best RMSEs By Number of Layers

Compute the best RMSEs for each number of ESN layers:

```{r}
best_rmses_by_layers <-
  cv_rmses |>
  select(-file) |>
  filter(folds == '4_and_5') |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rmse, rmse_extreme, rmse_weighted), 
    names_to = "rmse_type", 
    values_to = "rmse"
  ) |>
  filter(
    rmse == min(rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .by = c(target_region, tau, rmse_type, nlayers)
  )
```

Plot the best RMSEs for each set of model iterations:

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 12
#| echo: false
best_rmses_by_layers |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tau, y = rmse, group = nlayers, color = factor(nlayers))) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(rmse_type ~ target_region, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_light() + 
  labs(
    x = "Weeks Forecasted",
    y = "RMSE",
    title = "RMSEs by region (averaged over all test data)"
  ) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = wes_palette(name = "Zissou1", n = 3, type = "continuous")
  )
```

## Histograms of RMSEs

### Midwest

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 16
#| echo: false
cv_rmses |>
  filter(target_region == "MW") |>
  mutate(
    nh = factor(nh),
    m = factor(m),
    tau = factor(tau),
    nu = factor(nu),
    nlayers = factor(nlayers)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = rmse, 
    fill = nlayers
  )) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) + 
  facet_grid(
    paste("nlayers:", nlayers) ~ paste("horizon:", tau), 
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 14) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = wes_palette(name = "Zissou1", n = 3, type = "continuous")
  ) + 
  labs(title = "MW (all data)")

cv_rmses |>
  filter(target_region == "MW") |>
  mutate(
    nh = factor(nh),
    m = factor(m),
    tau = factor(tau),
    nu = factor(nu),
    nlayers = factor(nlayers)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = rmse_extreme, 
    fill = nlayers
  )) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) + 
  facet_grid(
    paste("nlayers:", nlayers) ~ paste("horizon:", tau), 
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 14) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = wes_palette(name = "Zissou1", n = 3, type = "continuous")
  ) +
  labs(title = "MW (extremes only)")

cv_rmses |>
```
